# `/identity-attributes` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /identity-attributes/v1

`listIdentityAttributesV1` — List identity attributes

Use this API to get a collection of identity attributes.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile-attribute:manage, idn:identity-profile-attribute:read
- Parameters:
  - `includeSystem` (query) — default False — Include 'system' attributes in the response.
  - `includeSilent` (query) — default False — Include 'silent' attributes in the response.
  - `searchableOnly` (query) — default False — Include only 'searchable' attributes in the response.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Returns 200: array of identityattribute-2

### POST /identity-attributes/v1

`createIdentityAttributeV1` — Create identity attribute

Use this API to create a new identity attribute.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile-attribute:manage
- Body (application/json): identityattribute-2
- Returns 201: identityattribute-2

### GET /identity-attributes/v1/{name}

`getIdentityAttributeV1` — Get identity attribute

This gets an identity attribute for a given technical name.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile-attribute:manage, idn:identity-profile-attribute:read
- Parameters:
  - `name` (path, required) — The attribute's technical name.
- Returns 200: identityattribute-2

### PUT /identity-attributes/v1/{name}

`putIdentityAttributeV1` — Update identity attribute

This updates an existing identity attribute. Making an attribute searchable requires that the `system`, `standard`, and `multi` properties be set to false.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile-attribute:manage
- Parameters:
  - `name` (path, required) — The attribute's technical name.
- Body (application/json): identityattribute-2
- Returns 200: identityattribute-2

### DELETE /identity-attributes/v1/{name}

`deleteIdentityAttributeV1` — Delete identity attribute

This deletes an identity attribute with the given name. The `system` and `standard` properties must be set to false before you can delete an identity attribute.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile-attribute:manage
- Parameters:
  - `name` (path, required) — The attribute's technical name.
- Returns 204: no body

### DELETE /identity-attributes/v1/bulk-delete

`deleteIdentityAttributesInBulkV1` — Bulk delete identity attributes

Use this API to bulk delete identity attributes for a given set of names. Attributes that are currently mapped in an identity profile cannot be deleted. The `system` and `standard` properties must be set to 'false' before you can delete an identity attribute.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile-attribute:manage
- Body (application/json): identityattributenames
- Returns 204: no body
